def coeff_var_log_growth(d):
    years = sorted(d.keys())
    growths = []
    for i in range(1, len(years)):
        growths.append(math.log(d[years[i]] / d[years[i-1]]))
    n = len(growths)
    mean = sum(growths) / n
    var = sum((g - mean)**2 for g in growths) / n  # population std
    sd = math.sqrt(var)
    return sd / mean
